mapper.select:
select date_format(paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, ifnull(sum(pay_amount - ifnull(refund_amount, 0)), 0) as sales, count(1) as orderCount from mall_order
group by date_format(paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by day

select date_format(paid_time, '%H') as hour, ifnull(sum(pay_amount - ifnull(refund_amount, 0)), 0) as sales, count(1) as orderCount from mall_order
group by date_format(paid_time, '%H') order by hour

select ifnull(pay_channel, 1) as channel, ifnull(sum(pay_amount - ifnull(refund_amount, 0)), 0) as amount, count(1) as orderCount from mall_order
group by ifnull(pay_channel, 1) order by amount desc

select o.store_id as storeId, ifnull(s.store_name, '未知店铺') as storeName, ifnull(sum(o.pay_amount - ifnull(o.refund_amount, 0)), 0) as sales, count(1) as orderCount from mall_order o left join store s on s.store_id = o.store_id and s.deleted = 0 where o.deleted = 0 and o.paid_time is not null and o.paid_time >= #{startTime} and o.paid_time < #{endTime} and o.pay_status in (1, 3, 4, 5) and ifnull(o.pay_channel, 1) in (1, 2) and o.store_id is not null group by o.store_id, s.store_name order by sales desc limit #{limit}
